color.note: Workbench colours follow the viewer's theme; the stage colours (stage, sky, group colours, bar) are the same in both themes.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: Page background of the workbench (body). Ground for ink and muted.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, fields, secondary buttons, start cards, dialogs. Ground for ink, head and muted.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Second surface: segment track, KPI tiles, attachments, hover of a request row. Ground for head, muted and ok.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body text on page, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: head
tokens.usage: Headings, labels, secondary and cancel button text, segment and chip text; on surface, surface-2 and fill-soft.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: hints, row facts, group icons, empty states; on page, surface and surface-2.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card and row borders, dividers, the border of unpressed segments.

tokens.name: field-line
tokens.usage: Border of fields, chips and outlined tags (.tag.cond), the divider between tag groups; at least 3:1 on surface.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Strong fill: .btn.primary, pressed segments and chips, the start-card hexagon; border of .btn.secondary.

tokens.name: on-fill
tokens.usage: Text and icons on fill.

tokens.name: fill-soft
tokens.usage: Soft fill: .btn.cancel, .icon-btn, neutral tags; text on it is head.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline on the workbench (3px, offset 3px); inside dark bars and bands it is replaced by sky. Also the bar fill in Dashboard charts.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and the required-field star; on surface and error-soft. Reserved: means error only.

tokens.name: error-line
tokens.usage: Border of an invalid field and of chips that no longer exist.

tokens.name: error-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of error messages and invalid fields; text on it is error.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Success and done (routing hint, status messages); on surface and surface-2. Reserved: means done only.

tokens.name: warn-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of notices, the test-mode banner and .tag.warn; text on it is warn-ink.

tokens.name: warn-ink
tokens.usage: Text on warn-soft; also the filled star of a rating.

tokens.name: front-text
tokens.usage: Links on the workbench (Front Door group colour as text); on page and surface.

tokens.name: hw-text
tokens.usage: Eyebrow text in the HW & SPaaS group colour; on surface.

tokens.name: hw-soft
tokens.usage: Soft ground in the HW & SPaaS group colour; held in reserve, app.css does not use it today.

tokens.name: vas-text
tokens.usage: Text in the VAS group colour on surface; held in reserve, app.css does not use it today.

tokens.name: type-spaas-bg
tokens.usage: Filled type badge "SPaaS" in My Requests and Dashboard; text on it is type-spaas-ink.

tokens.name: type-spaas-ink
tokens.usage: Text on type-spaas-bg.

tokens.name: type-order-bg
tokens.usage: Filled type badge "Order"; text on it is type-order-ink.

tokens.name: type-order-ink

tokens.name: type-partner-bg
tokens.usage: Filled type badge "Partner request" and every partner tag. Reserved partner blue: never a second meaning.

tokens.name: type-partner-ink
tokens.usage: Text on type-partner-bg (type badge and partner tags).

tokens.name: type-quote-bg
tokens.usage: Filled type badge "Quote" (saved SQT quotes). Checked: white on it 6.3:1 in light; type-quote-ink on it 9.6:1 in dark.

tokens.name: type-quote-ink
tokens.usage: Text on type-quote-bg (type badge "Quote").

tokens.name: type-swquote-bg
tokens.usage: Filled type badge "Software quote" (saved SWQT quotes, type swquote, 0.5.0). Wine red, kept apart from the quote ochre, the SPaaS violet and the reserved partner blue. Checked: white on it 8.0:1 in light; type-swquote-ink on it 8.1:1 in dark.

tokens.name: type-swquote-ink
tokens.usage: Text on type-swquote-bg (type badge "Software quote").

tokens.usage: Team tag Network (product team of a SPaaS request or order); text on it is team-network-ink.

tokens.usage: Text on team-network-bg.

tokens.name: team-huawei-bg
tokens.usage: Team tag Huawei (product team of a SPaaS request or order); text on it is team-huawei-ink.

tokens.usage: Text on team-huawei-bg.

tokens.usage: Team tag Tape (product team of a SPaaS request or order); text on it is team-tape-ink.

tokens.usage: Text on team-tape-bg.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: The hub stage, dark in both themes. Ground for stage-ink and stage-muted.

tokens.name: stage-bar
tokens.usage: Top bar, tool band, the hub filter track and, through bar-bg, the dark bars at the bottom. Ground for stage-ink, stage-muted and sky.

tokens.name: stage-ink
tokens.usage: Text on stage and stage-bar; also on the filled group hexagons of the hub, the hub "Open" pill (as its ground, with stage-bar text) and the story view buttons.

tokens.name: stage-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on the stage: band status line, hub tagline, planned tiles; on stage and stage-bar.

tokens.name: stage-line
tokens.usage: Lines on the stage: top edge of the tool band, border of area buttons.

tokens.name: stage-planned
tokens.usage: Fill of planned hexagon tiles on the hub.

tokens.name: stage-local
tokens.usage: Inner fill of hub tiles for a tool that is still local.

tokens.name: stage-legend
tokens.usage: Legend text at the bottom of the hub and the outline of the "Local tool today" pill; on stage (12.0:1).

tokens.name: stage-local-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the "Local tool today" pill on the stage (15.4:1 on stage, 13.9:1 on stage-local).

tokens.name: stage-raised
tokens.usage: Raised items on the stage: the avatar ground, hovered and focused items of the user menu and of the More menu in the dark bar, hovered story-view buttons. stage-ink on it 12.9:1.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Sky blue: current navigation item, main action in dark bars (.btn.prf-sky), focus ring on the stage; text on it is stage-bar.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Green accent of the stage; held in reserve, app.css does not use it today. Never use it for done, that is ok.

tokens.name: front
tokens.usage: Front Door group colour: filled hub hexagons; text on it is stage-ink.

tokens.name: front-ink
tokens.usage: Front Door group title on stage.

tokens.name: hw
tokens.usage: HW & SPaaS group colour: filled hub hexagons and the group hexagon on forms; text on it is stage-ink.

tokens.name: hw-ink
tokens.usage: HW & SPaaS group title on stage.

tokens.name: hw-rim
tokens.usage: Rim of local HW & SPaaS tiles on the hub.

tokens.name: vas
tokens.usage: VAS & PS group colour: filled hub hexagons; text on it is stage-ink.

tokens.name: vas-ink
tokens.usage: VAS & PS group title on stage; also the "all fields complete" line in the dark order bar.

tokens.name: vas-rim
tokens.usage: Rim of local VAS & PS tiles on the hub.

tokens.name: ph-front
tokens.usage: Outline of an empty placeholder hexagon in Front Door, around the stage (the hex is also at ph-opacity). In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--front) 45%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: ph-hw
tokens.usage: Outline of a placeholder hexagon in HW & SPaaS. In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--hw) 45%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: ph-vas
tokens.usage: Outline of a placeholder hexagon in VAS & PS. In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--vas) 50%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: hub-legend-line
tokens.usage: The fine line above the hub legend. In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-line) 50%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: topbar-hex
tokens.usage: Outline and fill of the hexagons in the top bar (T-102); drawn at 0.18 and 0.08 opacity, never as text.

tokens.name: story-bg
tokens.usage: Ground of the full-screen story view behind the 16:9 picture.

tokens.name: story-chip
tokens.usage: Dark chip under the picture credit in the story view, with story-credit-ink text (at least 5.3:1 even over white picture areas). In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-bar) 75%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: story-control
tokens.usage: Ground of the close button and the voice-over button of the story view, text stage-ink, border story-line; hover stage-raised. In the repo color-mix(in srgb, var(--stage-bar) 85%, transparent); same value.

tokens.name: story-credit-ink
tokens.usage: Text of the picture credit on story-chip.

tokens.name: story-line
tokens.usage: White pill borders, pointer lines and dots of the story view; border of its buttons.

tokens.name: bar-bg
tokens.usage: The dark bars fixed at the bottom (Find a rate selection, partner editor, order form); dark in both themes. Alias of stage-bar.

tokens.name: bar-ink
tokens.usage: Text on bar-bg. Alias of stage-ink.

tokens.name: bar-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bar-bg and the border of .btn.prf-on-dark. Alias of stage-muted.

tokens.name: bar-line
tokens.usage: Border of the dark bars and of disabled buttons in them. Alias of stage-line.

groups.name: Stage
groups.note: Brand type on the dark stage.

styles.name: text-wordmark
styles.usage: The vertical TITANIA wordmark on the hub, a button that opens the story view; size from the wordmark tokens (104px up to 820px screen height, 56px below 900px wide or up to 600px high, 36px horizontal at phone width), text shadow wordmark-shadow.

styles.name: text-brand
styles.usage: The TITANIA mark in the top bar, links to the hub.

styles.name: text-band-title
styles.sample: Partner Rate Finder · Find a rate
styles.usage: Title of a tool band, in stage-ink.

styles.name: text-hex-name
styles.usage: Name on a hub hexagon tile.

groups.name: Workbench
groups.note: Body 15px at line height 1.5; headings in 600.

styles.name: text-kpi
styles.usage: KPI value on the Dashboard (tabular figures).

styles.name: text-page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 of a page, in head.

styles.name: text-section-title
styles.usage: h2 of a section or settings card.

styles.name: text-card-title
styles.usage: Start-card title and the lead line of a confirmation page.

styles.name: text-body
styles.sample: Price and availability from the SPaaS teams, with attachments.
styles.usage: Body text, field values, buttons (600) and segment text (14px, 500).

styles.name: text-label
styles.usage: Field label, in head; also start-card text (400).

styles.name: text-small
styles.usage: Hints, band status line, row facts (500), field errors (500).

styles.name: text-eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above a form title, in hw-text.

styles.name: text-tag
styles.usage: Tags and status tags; the type badge uses line height 1.5.

styles.name: text-id
styles.usage: Request IDs in My Requests and Dashboard, in head.

spacing.note: Controls are 44px, the one main button 52px (docs/DESIGN.md section 2).

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of every control: fields, selects, segments, chips, buttons, navigation, checkbox rows.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Alias of control (44px), kept so older rules keep working; do not use it in new code.

tokens.name: control-main
tokens.usage: Height of the one main button of a page (.btn.main).

tokens.name: pad-field
tokens.usage: Inner horizontal padding of fields and selects.

tokens.name: pad-btn
tokens.usage: Inner horizontal padding of buttons (the main button uses 24px).

tokens.name: gap
tokens.usage: Standard gap: between start cards, inside a start card, between KPI tiles.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Side margin of form pages and of every page at phone width.

tokens.name: gutter-work
tokens.usage: Side margin of work pages, the top bar and the tool band on wide screens.

tokens.name: hub-groups-pad
tokens.usage: Extra space left of the hub groups, so they start right of the figures in the picture strip.

tokens.name: hub-brand-inset
tokens.usage: The hub wordmark from the left edge of the screen.

tokens.name: hub-brand-bottom
tokens.usage: The hub wordmark above the bottom edge of the screen.

tokens.name: hub-brand-gap
tokens.usage: Between the vertical wordmark and the vertical tagline.

tokens.name: story-line-w
tokens.usage: Stroke of the pointer lines in the story view, in the picture's 1600 x 900 units.

tokens.name: topbar-pad
tokens.usage: Space above and below the 44px controls in the top bar: a 64px bar (T-102).

radius.note: Soft corners; pills use 999px in place (type badge, filters).

tokens.name: r-field
tokens.usage: Fields, tags, notices, start cards, request rows, KPI tiles.

tokens.name: r-seg
tokens.usage: Segment buttons.

tokens.name: r-btn
tokens.usage: Buttons and the area buttons of a tool band.

tokens.name: r-card
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs and the dark bars at the bottom.

tokens.name: r-pill
tokens.usage: Fully rounded: the name pills, the close button and the voice-over button of the story view.

tokens.name: r-chip
tokens.usage: A small text chip on a picture (the story credit).

layout.note: Page types and fixed layout parts (docs/DESIGN.md sections 1 and 3).

tokens.name: w-qty
tokens.usage: Width of a quantity field in a table.

tokens.name: w-money
tokens.usage: Width of a price field in a table.

tokens.name: page-form
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a form page (centred).

tokens.name: page-work
tokens.usage: Maximum width of a work page; also the inner width of the top bar and the tool band on every page.

tokens.name: w-aside
tokens.usage: Width of the detail side panel to the right of a table.

tokens.name: bar-h
tokens.usage: Height of a one-line bar fixed at the bottom; the page keeps this much space free below.

tokens.name: pick-list-h
tokens.usage: Height of the scroll area for the rows of a picker inside a form (SWQT price list): 8½ rows of 57px, the cut row shows that the list scrolls; at most 60% of the screen. Same in light and dark.

tokens.name: hub-side
tokens.usage: Width of the hub brand column with the vertical wordmark (sticky, one screen high).

tokens.name: hub-strip
tokens.usage: Width of the Rackham picture strip behind the wordmark, one screen high.

tokens.name: hub-strip-narrow
tokens.usage: Width of the picture strip below 900px.

tokens.name: hex-w
tokens.usage: Width of a hub hexagon tile (same as HEX_W in src/domain/tiles.js); step 149px across.

tokens.name: hex-h
tokens.usage: Height of a hub hexagon tile (same as HEX_H); step 129px down.

tokens.name: topbar-strip
tokens.usage: Width of the picture strip in the top bar and of its fade; on narrower screens the fade spans the whole bar (T-102).

tokens.name: topbar-hex-w
tokens.usage: Width of the hexagon drawing in the top bar, right-aligned in the free space before the language switch; hidden below 720px.

tokens.name: topbar-hex-line
tokens.usage: Stroke width of the top bar hexagons (non-scaling).

shadow.note: Menus and the hub wordmark. Card, bar, dialog and preview-paper shadows are literal values in app.css and have no token.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: A menu on the workbench: the More menu of a list row (on surface, line border).

tokens.name: shadow-stage-pop
tokens.usage: A menu that drops from the stage or a dark bar: the user menu under the avatar, the More menu in the dark bar.

tokens.name: wordmark-shadow
tokens.usage: Text shadow of the vertical TITANIA wordmark on the hub picture strip (used as text-shadow).

fontSize.note: Font sizes the repo keeps as tokens. The full type scale is in Typography.

tokens.name: fs-body
tokens.usage: Body text, the hub tagline and the voice-over button.

tokens.name: fs-small
tokens.usage: Small text everywhere (T-77): hints, field errors, facts in list rows, pills, file names, secondary figures of the dark bar. Never a raw value.

tokens.name: wordmark
tokens.usage: The vertical TITANIA wordmark on the hub (style text-wordmark).

tokens.name: wordmark-short
tokens.usage: The wordmark on screens up to 820px high (laptops at 768 and 800px), so all of it stays on screen.

tokens.name: wordmark-narrow
tokens.usage: The wordmark below 900px wide and on screens up to 600px high.

tokens.name: story-close-glyph
tokens.usage: The x glyph of the story view close button.

opacity.note: Opacity on the stage: the hub and the top bar.

tokens.name: strip-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the Rackham picture strip behind the wordmark.

tokens.name: ph-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the empty placeholder hexagons.

tokens.name: topbar-strip-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the picture strip in the top bar (the hub strip uses strip-opacity).

tokens.name: topbar-hex-line-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the hexagon outlines in the top bar.

tokens.name: topbar-hex-fill-opacity
tokens.usage: Opacity of the three filled hexagons in the top bar.
